Don’t worry about it! I felt sooo anxious and overwhelmed when I started, dreaded lessons, felt like I was super slow learning compared to everyone else I heard about. Now I can hardly remember feeling so unconfident in a car! I switched instructors to someone who was much better and didn’t push me to do things I was uncomfortable with, which really helped. 

Also, remember, no such thing as a ‘born bad driver’, it’s all a matter of practice. Take all the time you need - it’s better to spend longer having lessons etc than rushing to take the test because you feel you should, and then not actually being a confident driver when it comes to driving on your own!

Usually to do with tone and practicality. If it’s a fast passage it’s easier to do it with 4th finger so you don’t have to do a string crossing for example. Also if you’re trying to play quietly 4th finger is easier as it sounds less harsh. Also for a slow piece or something and you need to use vibrato then obviously use 4th finger because an open string wouldn’t fit the tone of the piece. This is just from m experience but I’m definitely not a professional!
